value.rationale: The exact Euclidean additive relaxation error is a motivated, natural convex-geometric metric for cycle and cactus graph elliptope approximations. The theorem gives all worst-case geometric witnesses and their nearest realizable cut vectors, and proves a nontrivial square-sum accumulation across cactus cycles, contrasting with the maximum rule for multiplicative Grothendieck constants. It supplies an infinite natural family classification rather than a single unmotivated number.
